title: Make the English-text gate honest and green
summary: scripts/check_english_text.py returned rc=1 and was being ignored. Two causes: it scanned the git-ignored generated run directory assayer-output/, contradicting its own contract that generated output is never scanned; and several intentional locale surfaces were never allowlisted, including the frozen formal report format, the renderer that emits it, its tests, the SDK test that asserts non-ASCII identifiers are rejected, the historical Chinese lifecycle plan, and the approval records that must quote the approver name and the user's own words. This change excludes assayer-output/ from the scan, allowlists those locale surfaces by path with stated reasons, and removes four incidental Chinese leftovers from otherwise English authored files (two WS3 distribution metadata rows, one JSON example reason, and two test payload messages). The gate now returns 0 without deleting any intentional locale content.

platform: Repository development tooling owns the authored-text language gate

forbiddenResponsibilities: The gate must not be disabled, skipped, or made to pass by deleting intentional locale content
The change must not weaken the report-format contract or the non-ASCII rejection test
Generated output directories must never be treated as authored text
acceptance: scripts/check_english_text.py returns 0 and reports zero findings
assayer-output/ is excluded from the scan
the frozen report format, its renderer, its tests, the SDK non-ASCII test, the historical lifecycle plan, and design/changes are allowlisted by explicit path
the four incidental Chinese leftovers in otherwise English authored files are removed
check_document_boundaries.py, check_architecture_boundaries.py, check_plugin_source_boundaries.py, scripts/run_tests.py fast and full, and resilience_scan.py stay green
